items.q: How much does it cost to hire the RealLyfe Lawyer?
items.a: Nothing up front — we work on contingency; no fee unless we win.

items.q: How long do I have to file a claim?
items.a: Usually two years (three in New Mexico), with special rules for children — call promptly.

items.q: What is a mass tort vs. a class action?
items.a: In a mass tort you keep an individual claim; a class action resolves everyone's claims together.

items.q: Do you handle cases outside Texas, Oklahoma, New Mexico, and Arizona?
items.a: Yes — through a nationwide network of co-counsel.

items.q: Is birth injury the same as a birth defect?
items.a: No — a birth injury happens around delivery and may be caused by negligence; a birth defect is not.
